mandatory_limitations.title: Acceptance scope
mandatory_limitations.text: Accepted only for descriptive publication of these six actual saved Qwen3.5-2B/4B/9B-Base public TEST cells. This does not qualify a model, approve deployment, pass a research gate, establish generalization, amend a protocol, or authorize additional inference. Prior accepted 0.8B reference values and their limitations remain unchanged.

mandatory_limitations.title: Fixed protocol and no TEST selection
mandatory_limitations.text: Local readout is adapted letter logits for choice and Yes/No logits for noul, at T=1, float32, HF32 off, batch 1, max_length 8192, with no truncation. No training, temperature fitting, recipe/model/seed selection on TEST, or significance test occurred in this review. Readout and model sizes are fixed by the original plans.

mandatory_limitations.title: Populations and dependent observations
mandatory_limitations.text: Documents: 574 raw records, 936 questions, 395 changed-input/changed-gold observational pairs. Devtools: 900 raw records, 1073 questions, 454 such pairs. Multiple questions share records and pair memberships do not create independent samples; do not pool the two suites or present their questions/pairs as independent trials.

mandatory_limitations.title: 1073 primary and 1071 subset
mandatory_limitations.text: Devtools full1073 is the primary result. The separately labeled release-ID subset1071 excludes only zero-based question positions682 and744, both source ID codereviewer/cls-test/19245, raw rows570 and622. The release spec also names codereviewer/cls-test/13657, which contributes no TEST question here. Do not replace primary1073 with1071 or silently change the denominator.

mandatory_limitations.title: Duplicate and pair mapping
mandatory_limitations.text: Keep both duplicate-ID occurrences. Their different requests map by the frozen earliest-unused source ordinal rule to zero-based pair indices28 and29. The454 primary pairs are evaluated on full1073 and remain unchanged. Never attach454 pairs to the1071 masked population or recompute a replacement pair set; ID-only records cannot reveal unrecorded pairing intent.

mandatory_limitations.title: Discrimination, not causal consistency
mandatory_limitations.text: The pairs share a schema while both input and gold change. They are observational discrimination counterparts, not equivalence classes or minimal interventions. Changed-prediction and both-correct counts are descriptive; neither is an invariance or causal input-use result. Aggregate accuracy is not a consistency metric. Cross-size transitions do not warrant independent-pair significance or a monotonic scaling law.

mandatory_limitations.title: Native endpoint and training differences
mandatory_limitations.text: Native trained Kev-0.8B reference uses LoRA and a pointer head, key-plus-description options, false/no before true/yes, a native branch interface, and shipped T=2.3510958125672174. Its training includes documents-v1/devtools-v1 training splits. Local fixed Base uses chat rendering, description-only letter options or Yes/No, true before false, and T=1. Population masking cannot establish endpoint equivalence, isolate a training effect, or support training superiority, direct matched subtraction, or paired native significance.

mandatory_limitations.title: Native numbers are published context
mandatory_limitations.text: Native candidate.docs1_test and candidate.devtools_test in runs/release/kev-08b-r15.json have n936 and1071. Exact native TEST rows.json files are absent at the two release-spec paths checked; absence is path-specific. Native NLL is omitted from the release summaries and remains unavailable. Do not infer it or substitute development vectors, another checkpoint, or the publisher's parent-versus-candidate confidence intervals.

mandatory_limitations.title: Control and NLL conventions
mandatory_limitations.text: Constant-first and schema-majority controls are one-hot; uniform ties choose first, as do majority ties. Exact mathematical one-hot NLL is +infinity when gold probability is zero, represented as JSON null with positive infinite_nll_count. The probability-only floor1e-9 produces a separately labeled finite clipped diagnostic. Model exact logit NLL is unfloored. Uniform deterministic hard predictions and independent random-draw expectations must remain distinct.

mandatory_limitations.title: Oracle and descriptive additions
mandatory_limitations.text: TEST_majority_oracle_by_schema uses all TEST labels and is nondeployable. Schema means type/instructions/ordered keys/ordered descriptions; documents has10 groups and devtools108, including66 devtools singletons. Control conventions, schema grouping, token-length bins and n<30 flags are descriptive additions, not retroactive preregistration or new thresholds. A finite lookup table can memorize labels, schema constants can exploit priors, and random output can change often without understanding; controls and discrimination pairs expose these alternatives without proving mechanism.

mandatory_limitations.title: Adverse collapse and calibration findings
mandatory_limitations.text: Publish the adverse results with the headline rows. Devtools4B and9B predict false on150/150 code-review and150/150 flaky-test questions, with150 distinct logit vectors per task and changed0/75, both-correct0/75 per task. Their overall both-correct counts51/454 and68/454 are below2B112/454 despite higher aggregate accuracy. Every devtools Base size shown, including the prior0.8B reference, has Brier and exact NLL worse than uniform. Documents bank-account issue correctness is15/48,12/48,16/48 for2B/4B/9B, versus prior0.8B17/48.

mandatory_limitations.title: Small samples and unsupported recall
mandatory_limitations.text: Devtools2B confidence>=0.99 gives0 errors out of1 accepted question, not reliable calibration. Documents4B has23/401 errors at>=0.99, versus2B7/213 and9B12/459. Preserve operands for all perfect/zero, conditional, small-n and constant rates in the machine supplement. Documents3 and devtools8 task-qualified classes have zero gold support: recall is undefined/null, never0. Supported zero recall is a separate adverse result. n<30 is descriptive only.

mandatory_limitations.title: Original completion versus reconstruction
mandatory_limitations.text: All six original NPU, host, generic CPU and Kev CPU terminals bind their frozen plans and exit0; original CPU summaries and service/config/parent-intent receipts are present. None of these six cells required replacement of a missing original CPU result. The analysis attempt3 and this independent review are separate later reconstructions; their terminals cannot substitute for missing historical CPU completion in another cell. Earlier failed verifier attempts are retained and do not invalidate the separately verified final per-cell artifacts.

mandatory_limitations.title: Saved data and weights boundary
mandatory_limitations.text: Only candidate logits and saved request representations persist. Full-vocabulary arrays and actual historical input tensors are unavailable for independent replay. Weights were not rehashed; model identity uses the accepted PLAN weight manifest plus CONFIG, protocol, completion and every compact record. Accessed nonweight operands and tokenizer/metadata were rehashed. This verifies saved-data arithmetic and receipt binding, not hardware arithmetic, source-label validity, uncontaminated pretraining, or future performance.

mandatory_limitations.title: Allocation and process receipts
mandatory_limitations.text: Concurrent jobs legitimately change the global allocation ledger. Verification uses producer-serialized embedded hashes, continuity of this run/chip claim, claim removal and the exact release/free-entry pointer, not equality of the entire before/after ledger. Fresh read-only Docker inspection confirmed all six retained containers exited0 with their image/argv/mounts. Historical PIDs/start ticks remain historical receipts, not new liveness claims.

mandatory_limitations.title: Preregistration and source meaning
mandatory_limitations.text: Original frozen plans, metrics and pair lists remain normative and unchanged. Prior audit could not certify prospective devtools Wiki commit335b212; the current pinned Wiki snapshot is not preregistration. Source labels were not independently adjudicated; the native model card flags flaky-test and commit-change-type labels as problematic. Planning links documents to registry defects1,6,12,17 and devtools to1,5,9,17; these links and constructs are report-owned, not literature conclusions.

mandatory_limitations.title: Monitoring and publication limits
mandatory_limitations.text: No raw experiment log was consumed or new watcher false-positive diagnosis asserted. Canonical terminals, receipts, saved records and arithmetic establish completion. The review performs no source, Git, Wiki, allocation, NPU, training or original claim-state changes. Parent may publish only the exact approved rows and limitations; the analysis draft's pending-review language is superseded only for these six pinned cells.
